_doc: Round WH2 face stamps (2026-09-29), applied by tools/art-construct/wh2_px.py 'face' as the last pixel pass before the shading preset's remap. Every feature is re-anchored per still on the v2 head's own projected features (facepass.json: eye centroids, nose tip, chin), never on a fixed offset. Stamps are authored for a face turned toward +x (the near eye on the left, its outer corner at the left end); a face turned toward -x takes them mirrored. Legend: '.' keep, O OL, a A2 (iris top), c A3 (iris low), d A4 (crescent), w A5 (catchlight), W W2 (white), K I4 (pupil), k I3, 1-4 S1-S4, b SB. 'c' of a stamp = the cell (col, row, cell centres) that lands on the anchor. Every pixel is drawn only on head skin (hair stays on top). Mouth anchor: the face's centre line (nose tip to chin) at 'mouth_k' of the way from the nose to the chin.

idle_hero.note: signature idle: one-sided smirk, camera-side corner up 1 px; brow relaxed (the fringe's own brows kept)

n1_contact.note: focused: lid lowered 1 row, small set mouth

q_stamp.note: fierce, mid-attack: eyes OPEN and narrowed with the lid falling toward the nose, open mouth (never closed ^^ eyes on an attack frame)

n2_pivot.note: back glance over the shoulder: one profile eye, the smirk
